section:
### A further comparison between arms

Standard care is the usual blood pressure treatment given to every patient. Brostamide is a water tablet that helps the body clear extra salt. This comparison was run at the Oakfield Family Cohort.

Table 5. Counts and means for every group, measure and subset.

| Subset | Arm | Measure | Count | Total |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Younger adults, Normal kidney function, Community clinic | Standard care | Blood pressure control | 256 | 550 |
| Younger adults, Normal kidney function, Community clinic | Brostamide | Blood pressure control | 232 | 550 |

Each group is reported in the same way for every measure.
